claims.text: Calverton Industries requires an operations review across nine operating units to reduce indirect operating cost.
The review must baseline indirect cost across all operating units, identify and size improvement opportunities, and mobilise local delivery teams quickly across markets.
We will apply VCG’s four‑phase delivery methodology – Diagnose, Design, Deliver, Sustain – to structure the operations review.
A joint steering committee will be convened and will meet fortnightly to govern the engagement.
An Engagement Quality Director, independent of the delivery team, will be assigned to oversee quality for the duration of the project.
Knowledge‑transfer workshops will be conducted in the final four weeks to embed findings with local teams.
Leveraging VCG’s presence in 12 markets, we can mobilise local delivery teams within 10 business days of contract signature.
Our approach will include a baseline assessment of indirect costs across all nine operating units to establish a common cost reference.
In 2023, VCG delivered a global operations review for Halden Group covering nine operating units and achieved a 12 percent reduction in indirect operating cost over ten months.
The Halden engagement was mobilised within 10 business days, demonstrating our ability to deploy local delivery teams rapidly across markets.
VCG operates in 12 markets and has a delivery footprint of 2,000 consultants across six practices, enabling scalable support for multi‑unit reviews.
Our average engagement team size of seven consultants and a repeat‑engagement rate of 68 percent reflect our capacity to build trusted, effective teams.
We redesigned Larkfield Group’s operating model across five business units, removing three management layers and cutting decision‑cycle time by 31 percent.
For Meridian Industrial, VCG reduced outbound logistics cost by 14 percent and inventory carrying cost by 9 percent using our Network Optimiser toolkit.
Our proven four‑phase methodology, combined with rapid mobilisation capability, positions VCG to deliver the required cost‑reduction outcomes on the Calverton timeline.
The high repeat‑engagement rate (68 percent) indicates strong client satisfaction and long‑term partnership potential.
Our experience delivering a 12 percent indirect cost reduction across nine units directly aligns with Calverton’s objective to lower indirect operating costs.
The dedicated Engagement Quality Director and fortnightly steering committee ensure rigorous governance and quality assurance throughout the project.
